definition_en: To stop yourself from saying something you would regret.
example_en: I bit my tongue instead of arguing with my boss in the meeting.
example_uz: Yig'ilishda boshlig'im bilan tortishish o'rniga tilimni tishladim.
example_ru: Я прикусил язык вместо того, чтобы спорить с начальником на встрече.
common_mistake: The pronoun must match the subject: 'she bit her tongue'.

definition_en: To be the person who makes the important decisions.
example_en: Her father owns the company, but she calls the shots day to day.
example_uz: Kompaniya otasiniki, lekin kundalik qarorlarni u qabul qiladi.
example_ru: Компания принадлежит её отцу, но повседневно командует она.
synonyms: be in charge | run the show

definition_en: To discuss a problem openly so bad feelings disappear.
example_en: A short honest conversation cleared the air between the two teams.
example_uz: Qisqa samimiy suhbat ikki jamoa o'rtasidagi kelishmovchilikni bartaraf etdi.
example_ru: Короткий честный разговор разрядил обстановку между двумя командами.

definition_en: To end up in the same situation you started in, after many changes.
example_en: After years abroad he moved back to his village — life had come full circle.
example_uz: Chet elda yillar o'tkazgach u qishlog'iga qaytdi — hayot aylanib yana boshiga qaytdi.
example_ru: После лет за границей он вернулся в свою деревню — жизнь вернулась к началу.
common_mistake: No article: 'full circle', not 'a full circle'.

definition_en: To admit you were wrong and apologise, which feels humiliating.
example_en: When the figures proved him wrong, he had to eat humble pie.
example_uz: Raqamlar uning noto'g'ri ekanini isbotlagach, u xatosini tan olishga majbur bo'ldi.
example_ru: Когда цифры доказали его неправоту, ему пришлось признать свою ошибку.

definition_en: To hear about something secret or private, usually by accident.
example_en: The press got wind of the merger before it was announced.
example_uz: Matbuot qo'shilish haqida e'lon qilinishidan oldin shipshitib qoldi.
example_ru: Пресса прослышала о слиянии до объявления.
common_mistake: Followed by a noun: 'got wind of the plan'.

headword: give someone the benefit of the doubt
definition_en: To choose to believe someone even though you are not sure they are right.
example_en: He was late once, so I gave him the benefit of the doubt.
example_uz: U bir marta kechikdi, shuning uchun men uni gumon qilmay ishondim.
example_ru: Он опоздал один раз, и я поверил ему на слово.
word_family: give / gave someone the benefit of the doubt

definition_en: To change your opinion or decision about something.
example_en: She had planned to resign but had a change of heart after the offer.
example_uz: U ishdan ketmoqchi edi, ammo taklifdan keyin fikridan qaytdi.
example_ru: Она собиралась уволиться, но передумала после предложения.
word_family: have / had a change of heart

definition_en: To start a new job or task quickly and energetically.
example_en: She knew the industry well and hit the ground running in her first week.
example_uz: U sohani yaxshi bilardi va birinchi haftadanoq ishga jadal kirishdi.
example_ru: Она хорошо знала отрасль и сразу активно взялась за дело в первую неделю.

definition_en: To do many difficult or annoying things in order to get something.
example_en: We had to jump through hoops to get the visa approved.
example_uz: Vizani tasdiqlatish uchun biz ko'plab ortiqcha talablarga bo'ysunishga majbur bo'ldik.
example_ru: Нам пришлось пройти через бюрократию, чтобы одобрили визу.

definition_en: To avoid committing so you can still choose later.
example_en: He applied to three universities to keep his options open.
example_uz: U tanlov imkoniyatini ochiq qoldirish uchun uchta universitetga hujjat topshirdi.
example_ru: Он подал документы в три университета, чтобы оставить выбор открытым.

translation_ru: кто старое помянет, тому глаз вон
definition_en: To forgive an old quarrel and stop being angry about it.
example_en: They agreed to let bygones be bygones and work together again.
example_uz: Ular o'tganni o'tdi deb, yana birga ishlashga kelishishdi.
example_ru: Они решили забыть старое и снова работать вместе.
common_mistake: The word 'bygones' appears twice — that is the fixed form.

headword: make a mountain out of a molehill
definition_en: To treat a small problem as if it were much bigger.
ipa: meɪk ə ˈmaʊntɪn aʊt əv ə ˈməʊlhɪl
example_en: It was one typo — don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
example_uz: Bu bitta xato edi — ignadan tuya yasamang.
example_ru: Это была одна опечатка — не делайте из мухи слона.
word_family: make / making a mountain out of a molehill

definition_en: To reach an agreement by each side giving up something.
example_en: The landlord met us halfway and lowered the rent slightly.
example_uz: Uy egasi biz bilan murosaga kelib, ijara narxini biroz tushirdi.
example_ru: Хозяин пошёл нам навстречу и немного снизил аренду.

definition_en: Said privately and not intended to be quoted or published.
example_en: Off the record, the minister admitted the deadline was unrealistic.
example_uz: Rasmiy bo'lmagan holda, vazir muddat real emasligini tan oldi.
example_ru: Не для печати министр признал, что срок нереален.
word_family: off the record / on the record

definition_en: Left aside for now, to be dealt with later.
example_en: The redesign is on the back burner until the budget is approved.
example_uz: Byudjet tasdiqlanmaguncha qayta loyihalash keyinga qoldirilgan.
example_ru: Редизайн отложен на потом, пока не утвердят бюджет.
word_family: put something on the back burner
common_mistake: Use 'the back burner', not 'a back burner'.

definition_en: To set a higher standard than before.
example_en: Their new album really raised the bar for the whole genre.
example_uz: Ularning yangi albomi butun janr uchun talabni sezilarli oshirdi.
example_ru: Их новый альбом действительно поднял планку для всего жанра.

definition_en: A practical guideline based on experience rather than exact calculation.
example_en: As a rule of thumb, allow twenty minutes per exam question.
example_uz: Taxminiy qoida sifatida, har bir imtihon savoliga yigirma daqiqa ajrating.
example_ru: Как эмпирическое правило, отводите двадцать минут на вопрос экзамена.
common_mistake: Usually introduced by 'as a rule of thumb'.

definition_en: So familiar that you do it without thinking.
example_en: After a year of driving daily, parking became second nature.
example_uz: Bir yil har kuni haydagach, mashinani qo'yish odat tusiga kirdi.
example_ru: После года ежедневного вождения парковка вошла в привычку.

definition_en: Fixed and impossible to change.
example_en: The schedule is a draft — nothing is set in stone yet.
example_uz: Jadval qoralama — hali hech narsa qat'iy belgilanmagan.
example_ru: Расписание черновое — пока ничто не высечено в камне.
common_mistake: Often used in the negative: 'not set in stone'.

definition_en: To be very careful not to upset someone.
example_en: Since the argument, everyone has been walking on eggshells around him.
example_uz: Janjaldan beri hamma u bilan ehtiyotkorlik bilan muomala qilmoqda.
example_ru: После ссоры все ходят вокруг него как по яичной скорлупе.
